# Ghostlab

> An OpenShell-first, end-to-end testing lab for configured AI agents.
> An evaluated agent can combine a runner, instructions, MCP servers, skills,
> workspace files, and assets. Coding agents role-play real users over multiple
> turns; Ghostlab captures traces, scores outcomes, compares regressions, and can
> render and interact with MCP Apps `ui://` widgets.

The Python package is `rehearsal`; the installed CLI is `ghostlab` (alias
`rehearsal`). It uses the stdlib for MCP transport (stdio / streamable-HTTP+SSE),
shells out to coding-agent CLIs, and runs agent sessions and local stdio MCPs in
NVIDIA OpenShell by default. `--sandbox local` is the explicit unsandboxed
compatibility opt-out; there is no automatic fallback. Pipeline:
**understand → generate → run → evaluate**, with optional SQLite persistence, a
Streamlit UI, and an MCP Apps render layer.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/README.md): full overview, install, and a worked example of every command.
- [Docs wiki](https://sajjadgg.github.io/Ghostlab/): hosted MkDocs documentation.
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to set up, run tests, and open a PR (read this before contributing).

## Architecture (key modules under `rehearsal/`)

- [cli.py](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/rehearsal/cli.py): argparse entry point; one `cmd_*` per pipeline command.
- [agents.py](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/rehearsal/agents.py): load and normalize composed agent definitions, including MCPs, skills, workspace, assets, and inline tests.
- [sandbox.py](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/rehearsal/sandbox.py): NVIDIA OpenShell lifecycle, upload/env policy, execution, logs, artifact download, and cleanup.
- [mcp_client.py](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/rehearsal/mcp_client.py): minimal stdlib MCP client (stdio + streamable-HTTP/SSE), `tools/list`, `resources/read`, `tools/call`.
- [inspect.py](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/rehearsal/inspect.py) + [profile.py](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/rehearsal/profile.py): understand a target MCP and build a capability profile.
- [generate.py](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/rehearsal/generate.py), [personas.py](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/rehearsal/personas.py), [dataset.py](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/rehearsal/dataset.py): scenario / persona / dataset generation (codex-backed).
- [orchestrator.py](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/rehearsal/orchestrator.py) + [runners.py](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/rehearsal/runners.py): the dual-agent turn loop and agent-host adapters.
- [tool_capture.py](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/rehearsal/tool_capture.py): structured MCP tool-call capture from agent output.
- [evaluate.py](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/rehearsal/evaluate.py) + [compare.py](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/rehearsal/compare.py): deterministic + codex-judge verdicts and regression diffs.
- [storage/](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/tree/main/rehearsal/storage): SQLite persistence (`GhostlabStore`).
- [mcp_apps.py](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/rehearsal/mcp_apps.py) + [apps_host/](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/tree/main/rehearsal/apps_host): MCP Apps host layer — detect, diagnose, render, and drive `ui://` widgets.

## Commands (the `ghostlab` CLI)

- `create`: build an agent-, MCP-, or skill-evaluation job; OpenShell is the default sandbox.
- `config`: print the exact resolved runner command, four model roles, composed inputs, and OpenShell settings (`--json` for automation).
- `discover` / `plan` / `test` / `review`: run the job pipeline and release gate.
- `inspect`: connect to a target MCP and capture tools/resources/prompts (+ lint).
- `profile`: turn an `inspect.json` into a capability profile.
- `generate-scenarios` / `generate-personas` / `generate-dataset`: build persona × scenario test data.
- `review-dataset`: coverage, flags, and per-case approve/reject.
- `run` / `run-dataset`: run the dual-agent E2E loop, one scenario or a whole dataset; both default real runners to OpenShell.
- `evaluate` / `compare`: score a run and diff two runs for regressions.
- `apps-probe` / `apps-render`: probe and render MCP Apps `ui://` widgets.
- `db` / `ui`: SQLite history and the Streamlit pipeline UI.

The complete `create` pipeline requires at least one real semantic/security
conversation. Placeholder-only plans and all-skipped semantic runs return
non-zero. Standalone callers can enforce the same contract with
`plan --require-semantic` and `test --require-semantic`.

## Examples (config you can copy)

- [examples/](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/tree/main/examples): ready-to-run agent, skill, target, scenario, and `mcpServers` configs.
- [runners/](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/tree/main/runners): agent-runner presets (Codex process / session).
- [specs/](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/tree/main/specs): end-to-end design specs (vanilla MCP + MCP Apps).

## Contributing & issues

- [Open issues](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/issues): good entry points are labeled by pipeline stage (`pipeline:run`, `pipeline:evaluate`, …).
- [Tests](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/tree/main/tests): run `python -m pytest`; most logic is browser-free and unit-tested.
- To contribute: fork or branch, keep changes Python 3.9-syntax-safe, add tests, and open a PR against `main`. See [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Optional

- [pyproject.toml](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/pyproject.toml): packaging, optional extras (`ui`, `apps`, `dev`), console scripts.
- [Streamlit UI](https://github.com/sajjadGG/Ghostlab/blob/main/rehearsal/ui/app.py): browser front-end over the pipeline.
